title: Observation of stacked vortex structure with number controllable Majorana zero mode in Bi2Te3/FeTe heterojunction
why_careful: Moderately careful: bare-FeTe versus Bi2Te3-covered spectra, measurements in defect-free regions, multi-peak fits separating the zero-bias peak from discrete CdGM levels, direction-resolved decay lengths, ARPES on annealed and as-grown FeTe, and a statement that every measured vortex shows the zero mode.

spans:
Notably,
MZMs are observed in all measured vortices, and their number can be tuned by magnetic field
and the size of Bi2Te3 islands.
info.why: the only statement of how many of the measured vortices show the zero-bias peak (it appears only in the abstract)

spans:
To minimize possible defect-related
effects, we performed the measurements in a defect-free region at 0.4 K under a perpendicular
magnetic field of 1.0 T.
info.why: the only statement that the vortex spectra were taken away from defects

spans:
To detailed explore the spatial evolution
of low energy states in the vortex core, we extract five discrete states at −2.1 ± 0.13 meV (L-2),
−0.93 ± 0.14 meV (L-1), 0.003 ± 0.11 meV (L0), 0.79 ± 0.17 meV (L1), and 1.96 ± 0.22 meV
 (L2) from the spectra by multi-peak fitting, which approximately follow an integer quantized
sequence (Fig. 3G).

Five discrete integer energy bound states are extracted, with
no obviously dispersion.
info.why: the multi-peak fit is what separates the zero-energy level from the neighbouring discrete CdGM levels

info.check: The CdGM spacing is about ∆²/EF; with the stated gaps of 1.85-2.92 meV and EF ~300 meV this is 0.01-0.03 meV, not 0.03 µeV.
